title: How Track3D's internal tools are protected
question: Which internal tools must only Track3D staff reach, and how is that enforced: support-user flag, a staff role, a separate identity provider or network restriction? What may internal tools log, and may internal dashboard data be cached across users?
context: Per-company TechOps email routing is written into code (OPS-REQ-010). The control-panel PRD restricts exports to support users.
